name: Telgte (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, green and white in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Telgte (a green tree on white).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident Münster of 31 March 1976 the city of Telgte was granted the right to bear its arms and, by the same deed, the flag, described as white, green and white striped 1:3:1 with the city shield in the middle of the green stripe.

features.role: Telgte arms — green tree on white
